blocks.content: The accumulate() function computes the sum of all the elements in the given range along with a given initial value.
Let's look at the function signature first,
Type accumulate(iterator first, iterator last, Type init_val);

items: first : Iterator to the first element of the range.
last : iterator to the last element of the range.
init_val : the initial value that is added to the sum.

blocks.content: This function returns the sum of the elements in the given range including the given initial value.
